CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auth_role()
 RETURNS user_role
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
  SELECT role FROM profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_entity_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$SELECT NULLIF(
    (current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::jsonb -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'entity_id'),
    ''
  )::uuid;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_entity_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
  SELECT current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::jsonb -> 'app_metadata' ->> 'entity_role';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_deduct_stock_on_confirmation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_item         RECORD;
  v_ingredient   RECORD;
  v_current_stock numeric(10,4);
  v_total_needed  numeric(10,4);
BEGIN
  -- Gate: only fire on confirmation transitions
  IF NEW.to_status <> 'confirmed' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- Gate: idempotency — check if deduction already exists for this order
  -- This prevents double-deduction if somehow the trigger fires twice
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM inventory_movements
    WHERE order_id = (
      SELECT order_id FROM order_status_log WHERE id = NEW.id
    )
    AND reason = 'order_consumption'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Inventory already deducted for order %. Duplicate confirmation detected.',
      NEW.order_id;
  END IF;

  -- Iterate over each order line item
  FOR v_item IN
    SELECT
      oi.id            AS order_item_id,
      oi.item_id,
      oi.quantity      AS ordered_quantity
    FROM order_items oi
    WHERE oi.order_id = NEW.order_id
      AND oi.deleted_at IS NULL
  LOOP
    -- For each ingredient in this item's BOM
    FOR v_ingredient IN
      SELECT
        ii.ingredient_id,
        ii.quantity_required,
        i.unit,
        i.name          AS ingredient_name,
        i.cost_per_unit
      FROM item_ingredients ii
      JOIN ingredients i ON i.id = ii.ingredient_id
      WHERE ii.item_id = v_item.item_id
        AND ii.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND i.deleted_at IS NULL
      FOR UPDATE OF i
    LOOP
      v_total_needed := v_ingredient.quantity_required * v_item.ordered_quantity;

      -- Read current ledger balance (from cache for performance, validated below)
      SELECT current_stock INTO v_current_stock
      FROM ingredient_stock_cache
      WHERE ingredient_id = v_ingredient.ingredient_id
      FOR UPDATE;  -- Lock cache row too

      -- Stock guard: prevent overselling at database level
      IF v_current_stock < v_total_needed THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
          'Insufficient stock for ingredient "%" (id: %). Required: %, Available: %',
          v_ingredient.ingredient_name,
          v_ingredient.ingredient_id,
          v_total_needed,
          v_current_stock;
      END IF;

      -- Insert negative movement (deduction)
      INSERT INTO inventory_movements (
        ingredient_id,
        delta,
        reason,
        order_id,
        order_item_id,
        performed_by,
        unit_cost_at_time,
        note
      ) VALUES (
        v_ingredient.ingredient_id,
        -v_total_needed,                       -- negative = outflow
        'order_consumption',
        NEW.order_id,
        v_item.order_item_id,
        NEW.changed_by,                        -- the clerk who confirmed
        v_ingredient.cost_per_unit,
        'Auto-deducted on order confirmation'
      );

    END LOOP;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_lock_movement_row()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION
    'inventory_movements rows are immutable. Attempted % on row id=%. '
    'To correct a movement, insert a compensating row.',
    TG_OP, OLD.id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_reverse_stock_on_cancellation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_move RECORD;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.to_status <> 'cancelled'
     OR NEW.from_status NOT IN ('confirmed', 'ready') THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM inventory_movements
    WHERE order_id = NEW.order_id
      AND reason = 'cancellation_reversal'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Cancellation reversal already recorded for order %. Duplicate detected.',
      NEW.order_id;
  END IF;

  FOR v_move IN
    SELECT id, ingredient_id, delta, unit_cost_at_time, order_item_id
    FROM inventory_movements
    WHERE order_id = NEW.order_id
      AND reason = 'order_consumption'
  LOOP
    INSERT INTO inventory_movements (
      ingredient_id,
      delta,
      reason,
      order_id,
      order_item_id,
      performed_by,
      unit_cost_at_time,
      note
    ) VALUES (
      v_move.ingredient_id,
      -v_move.delta,
      'cancellation_reversal',
      NEW.order_id,
      v_move.order_item_id,
      NEW.changed_by,
      v_move.unit_cost_at_time,
      'Auto-reversed on order cancellation from status: ' || NEW.from_status
    );
  END LOOP;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_update_stock_cache()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO ingredient_stock_cache (ingredient_id, current_stock, last_updated_at)
  VALUES (NEW.ingredient_id, NEW.delta, now())
  ON CONFLICT (ingredient_id) DO UPDATE
    SET current_stock   = ingredient_stock_cache.current_stock + EXCLUDED.current_stock,
        last_updated_at = now();

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_entity_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- 1. Profile row
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, email, username)
  VALUES (
    NEW.id,
    NEW.email,
    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'username', split_part(NEW.email, '@', 1))
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

  -- 2. Resolve single active entity
  SELECT id INTO v_entity_id
  FROM public.entities
  WHERE is_active = true
  ORDER BY created_at ASC
  LIMIT 1;

  -- 3. Auto-enroll as 'user' (office/clerk must be manually elevated)
  IF v_entity_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.entity_members (entity_id, profile_id, role, is_active, joined_at)
    VALUES (v_entity_id, NEW.id, 'user', true, now())
    ON CONFLICT (entity_id, profile_id) DO NOTHING;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE public.rebuild_stock_cache()
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $procedure$
BEGIN
  -- Disable trigger temporarily (requires superuser in Supabase)
  -- Alternative: use a flag column approach — see note below
  DELETE FROM ingredient_stock_cache;

  INSERT INTO ingredient_stock_cache (ingredient_id, current_stock, last_updated_at)
  SELECT
    ingredient_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(delta), 0),
    now()
  FROM inventory_movements
  GROUP BY ingredient_id;
END;
$procedure$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_order_total()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE orders
  SET total_price = (
    SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price_at_order)
    FROM order_items
    WHERE order_id = NEW.order_id
  )
  WHERE id = NEW.order_id;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
